task.description: WF-02 Step 2c: SECURITY-REVIEWER hard gate on REQ-377's implementation (git diff main...HEAD on feature/WF02-REQ377-20260922 as of commit 2d9eb30e). New admin-only backend HTTP surface (Letflow.Routers.EventRetention: GET /summary, POST /retirements, GET /retirements/:id), platform-wide tenant-schema fanout, two new global (non-tenant-prefixed) tables, a requested_by column shipped without an FK (deviation from the design doc, flagged for scrutiny).
acceptance_criteria: the retirement screen lets a PLATFORM_ADMIN retire the oldest eligible month and displays the resulting retirement record, matching EO-001's operator-console evidence requirement
the retention summary shows a protected-record count capturable before and after a retirement, matching EO-002's evidence requirement
the screen is reachable only to a PLATFORM_ADMIN-equivalent role from the operator console navigation
web/tests/e2e/pipelines/platform-partition-retention-drop.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts is authored against this real screen and passes

result.summary: Scope test: applies (new admin API surface, new migration, new response-shaping code, platform-wide tenant-schema fanout). Ran the full INV-1..INV-8 assessment against `git diff main...HEAD`. INV-1 (tenant isolation): PASS -- schema_name always system-derived from provisioned_tenant_schemas/0, re-validated by tenant_id_for_schema_name/1 before any query; the two new tables are correctly tiered as global (matching platform_migration_rollouts precedent), no tenant business-data content leaks into them. INV-2/INV-3/INV-5: NOT-APPLICABLE (not a client-response-shaping or lookup-by-ID case in the relevant sense). INV-4 (secrets): PASS, no secret material touched. INV-7 (no SQL string interpolation of untrusted input into identifiers): PASS -- eligible_months/1 and count_protected_rows_in_schema/3 bind schema_name as a parameterized value already validated upstream; POST /retirements has an empty request body by design (oldest-eligible-month is always system-computed, never caller-supplied); requested_by is sourced from conn.assigns.auth_context.user_id (server-derived), never interpolated into SQL, flows only through parameterized Ecto/changeset paths. The no-FK deviation on requested_by (users is tenant-scoped per decision 0006 D1/D2, this table is global) is a referential-integrity relaxation, not a security defect -- no injection surface, no cross-tenant leakage risk, attribution-only value. INV-8 (no unhandled crashes): PASS -- retire_one_schema/5 and run_retirement/4 both wrap in rescue and record typed failure reasons (inspect(error), never raw exception/stacktrace text); tenant_outcome.reason confirmed to never leak raw error messages. Authorization check: confirmed (not just documented) that all 3 routes are gated via authz_get/authz_post macros with :TenantsManage, Authorize plug runs before :dispatch, and authorization.ex's endpoint_policy_key/2 clauses map all 3 paths correctly.
